learning_curve.description: Sequential incident pair testing whether recorded remediation failure prevents repeated faulty recommendations.

memory_on.notes: Initial candidate rollback applied; verification confirms failure (latency persists).

memory_off.notes: Initial candidate rollback applied; verification confirms failure (latency persists).

memory_on.memory_adaptation: Learned from inc_learn_01 failure: rejected 'rb_rollback', selected alternative 'rb_circuit_breaker'.

memory_off.memory_adaptation: No episodic memory; repeated the previously failed 'rb_rollback'.

learning_curve.conclusion: Memory ON demonstrated empirical adaptation by learning from step 1 failure and selecting an alternative successful fix on step 2. Memory OFF repeated the failed fix across identical incidents.
